title: $1,126,661 on Ads. His Own Text: "Disaster Zone."

lines.say: One million, one hundred twenty-six thousand, six hundred sixty-one dollars. Theranos wired that on August third, twenty fifteen, to buy ads for its blood-testing Wellness Centers.
lines.show: $1,126,661. Theranos wired that on August 3, 2015, to buy ads for its blood-testing Wellness Centers.
